claims: Artemis II successfully launched on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
Artemis II launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
Artemis II launched from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis II launched from Launch Complex 39B, Kennedy Space Center.
The Artemis II launch window opened at 6:24 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II launch window was two hours long.
Artemis II lifted off slightly after the opening of its two-hour launch window.
Artemis II is a 10-day crewed mission around the Moon.
The four astronauts for Artemis II are Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis II is the first crewed flight to the moon since 1972.
